content.comment_body: How can I send an online command from a PC to a [product_name], using Ethernet to control an AC motor (turn it ON or OFF)?

You can use the embedded Web server, which mirrors the display of the [product_name] and provides virtual access to its keys. This enables you to interact with the device even if hardware operator panels like [product_name] TDE are not present.
A new question published by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread regarding [product_name] and sending online commands from a PC. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for solutions to remotely operate a [product_name], specifically sending ON/OFF commands to control an AC motor over Ethernet from their computers. There is clarification that a built-in Web server offers a virtual interface, making physical controls accessible remotely—even without certain hardware modules like [product_name] TDE—though some may not initially know about this feature.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to send remote ON/OFF commands from a computer via Ethernet to a [product_name] for controlling an AC motor, expecting reliable and straightforward remote operation.
